title: Projects
folderProjectsMoveNote: {count} project(s) will move to the list root (folder does not delete projects).

wizard.title: New Project
wizard.description: Choose pipeline architecture and enter project name. Mechanics are fixed to the project upon creation.
wizard.v1Desc: End-to-end linear production from general concept to final shots. Fast, simple, and stable.
wizard.v1Feature1: Auto-script: single video text and timing
wizard.v1Feature2: Linear storyboard: shots built sequentially along text
wizard.v1Feature3: Batch generation: parallel render of images and video (KIE / Flux / Seedance)
wizard.v1Feature4: Quick edit: instant export to Premiere / CapCut
wizard.v1ChannelsDesc: Shorts, Reels, TikTok, educational facts, quotes, high-volume conveyor channels.
wizard.v2Desc: Dramatic approach with division into scenes, emotional beats, and takes. Full control over characters, locations, and cinematography.
wizard.v2Feature1: Scene design: characters, environment, lighting, and angles for each scene
wizard.v2Feature2: Narrative beats: setting narrative accents and story pacing
wizard.v2Feature3: Take system: shot variations (shot_01, shot_02) and best take selection
wizard.v2Feature4: Editing board: flexible shot coverage and precise editorial rhythm
wizard.v2ChannelsDesc: Long-form videos (YouTube 16:9), documentaries, story-driven narratives, creator channels with deep direction.

queue.title: Generation Queue
queue.desc: Project #{id} — which node to run up to?
queue.runFullDesc: Until publishing or end of pipeline
queue.footerNote: Requires AI mode enabled. HITL checkpoints are passed automatically in auto_mode.
queue.needAutoMode: Enable AI mode (auto_mode) for the project
